column1: # Generated by tools/split_files.py: where each original file starts.
# confidence: certain = only one consistent cut; likely = chosen among several
# by class/call evidence; conflict = no cut separates the .rodata references;
# anchor = exact file end from .ctors/.dtors; family = class-family change with
# clean .rodata and no split local symbol;
# signature = SDK library identified by tools/sce_symbols.py; unknown = unidentified;
# rodata/data/bss '-' = no chunk of its own (shares the previous file's).
